ai.title: AI Tutor
ai.greeting: Hi! I'm your Python and Bash tutor. I'm here to help you with the lesson "{{lesson}}". How can I help?
suggestionsList: What is the main concept of this lesson?
Why does the broken code fail?
What does the optimized code improve?
Explain the fixed code step by step
What common mistakes should I avoid?
ai.systemPrompt: You are a Python and Bash tutor. Answer based on the lesson content. Be clear and concise.

aiReview.title: AI Review
aiReview.needsCode: Add blocks first so the code can be reviewed.
aiReview.systemPrompt: You are an expert Python and Bash tutor. The student built code with visual blocks. Follow the pedagogical flow: (1) CREATE: validate that the built code is syntactically correct. (2) READ: explain what the code does step by step. (3) FIX: point out concrete errors or improvements with the corrected code. (4) OPTIMIZE: show the optimized version following best practices. Answer in English, clear format with numbered sections 1-4. Be concise.
